intake.label: Video link
intake.help: YouTube, a playlist or channel, or a link from any other site. Or drop a file here.
intake.invalid: That doesn't look like a video link. Copy it from the browser's address bar and try again.
intake.fetching: Downloading the video from the site… {pct}%
intake.fetchFailed: Couldn't download the video from that site.
intake.dropHint: It goes to your local server and opens right away

home.title: Any video, in Arabic, right on time.
home.lead: Line-by-line synced translation and natural dubbing, running on your computer.

preview.line: يحوّل ترجمان كل جملة إلى لغتك، في وقتها تمامًا.

recent.title: Continue watching
recent.emptyBody: Videos you open show up here so you can pick up where you left off.

subs.title: Synced subtitles on the video
subs.body: The translation appears on the picture as it is spoken, with the full transcript to search and jump around in. No captions? Whisper transcribes the speech on your computer.

dub.title: Live dubbing
dub.body: A natural voice speaks over the speaker, paced to each sentence.

export.title: Files to take with you
export.body: An SRT or VTT subtitle file, or an MP4 with subtitles or dubbed.

ask.title: Ask about the video
ask.body: A summary and chapters, and answers that take you to the right moment.

learn.title: Learn English from it
learn.body: Tap any word for its meaning and save it with its sentence.

status.title: Your computer
status.up: The local server runs on port {port}, version {version}.

down.title: The local server is not running
down.body: Tarjuman runs on your computer. Start it from the app folder with this command, then reload:

translate.title: Translation
translate.cooling: Google is paused for a while; using the fallback.

whisper.title: Whisper speech-to-text
whisper.missing: Not installed. Videos without captions can't be transcribed.

voices.title: Dubbing voices
voices.missing: Not installed. Only online voices will be used.

ffmpeg.title: FFmpeg for MP4 files
ffmpeg.ok: Ready to make dubbed and subtitled videos.
ffmpeg.missing: Not found. MP4 files won't work.

ai.title: AI
ai.off: Off. Optional: for summaries, questions and more natural dubbing.

watch.resumed: Picked up where you left off ({time})
watch.embedBlocked: The owner doesn't allow this video to play outside YouTube. Subtitles, downloads and files still work from the panel below.
watch.playerError: The player couldn't play this video (code {code}).

ytFailed.title: Couldn't load the YouTube player
ytFailed.body: The YouTube player needs an internet connection. Check it and try again.

whisper.title: This video has no captions on YouTube
whisper.body: We can download the audio and transcribe it with Whisper on your computer, without uploading it anywhere, then translate it.
whisper.bodyLocal: Whisper transcribes the speech on your computer and we translate it; then the video opens.
whisper.missing: Whisper isn't installed yet. Install it with this command, then try again:
whisper.note: Whisper takes about ten seconds per minute of audio.

translate.unavailable: The translation service isn't answering. We'll try again later.

edit.saved: Saved. It will show in the subtitles, downloads and dubbing.

opts.title: Subtitles on screen
opts.bilingualHint: Tap any word for its meaning. Shortcut B

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.editHint: Enter to save, Esc to cancel

dub.wait: Wait for the dub when it falls behind
dub.waitHint: The video pauses for a moment instead of cutting a sentence

live.title: Live dubbing
live.lead: A real voice speaks over the speaker while you watch. The video holds for a moment at the start until the first sentence is ready.
live.needPlayer: Wait until the video is ready.

state.waiting: Waiting for the sentence to end

fmt.label: Format
fmt.hint: SRT for most players, VTT for the web

subs.title: Subtitle file
subs.done: Downloaded, with a copy in your Library.

mp4.title: MP4 video
mp4.lead: One file to watch anywhere or send to someone. It runs in the background; you can close this page.

subvideo.title: With subtitles on the picture
subvideo.lead: Original audio with the subtitles drawn on the picture, using the “Text” choice above.
subvideo.ready: The subtitled video is ready, and in your Library.

dub.title: Dubbed with an Arabic voice
dub.lead: Slower than live dubbing, but the timing is more precise.
dub.embed: Put the subtitles inside the file
dub.embedHint: Turned on and off in the player
dub.removeHint: Music and effects stay. Takes about one and a half times the video length
dub.burn: Burn the subtitles onto the picture
dub.burnHint: Shows in any player, but takes longer
dub.refit: {n} sentences sped up to fit their time
dub.multiSpeaker: a matching voice for each speaker

setup.title: Turn on AI first
setup.body: Summaries and questions need an AI provider: Claude, a free one like Gemini or Groq, or Ollama on your computer.

summary.title: Summary and chapters
summary.lead: The idea of the video in a paragraph, the key points, and chapters you can jump to.
summary.busy: Summarizing… the first time takes a while

ask.title: Ask about the video
ask.label: Your question about the video
ask.placeholder: For example: what steps did they explain?

learn.learnHint: The video pauses after every sentence so you can read it. Shortcut L
learn.learnOn: Learning mode: pauses after every sentence
learn.loopHint: The same sentence repeats until you turn it off. Shortcut O
learn.quizHint: It shows when you hover it. Test yourself
learn.emptyTitle: No words saved from this video
learn.emptyBody: Tap any English word in the transcript or the subtitles to see its meaning and save it.

library.title: Library
library.lead: Running jobs, playlists, your videos and the files you've made. Everything stays on your computer.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.emptyBody: When you make a dubbed or subtitled video or start a playlist, its progress shows here.

batch.title: A whole playlist or channel
batch.lead: Paste the link and let it work through the videos one by one. You can leave it running overnight.
batch.fromPlaylist: That's a playlist. Choose what to make, then press Start.
batch.fromChannel: That's a channel. Choose what to make for its videos, then press Start.
batch.needUrl: Paste a playlist or channel link.
batch.started: The batch started. You can close the page; the work continues on your computer.

media.title: My videos
media.emptyBody: Upload a file from the home page, or paste a link from any site.

files.title: Files
files.dubbedEmpty: No videos made yet. Open a video and use Export.
files.subsEmpty: Subtitle files you download are kept here too.

words.title: Words
words.lead: The words you saved, each with the sentence it came from.
words.emptyBody: While watching, tap any English word in the transcript to see its meaning, then “Save to Words”.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: These settings are kept on this device.
settings.defaultsLead: Used when you open a new video and when making files.
settings.voiceHint: Automatic picks a voice that matches the speaker in MP4s
settings.shortcutsLead: They work on the watch page, with Arabic keyboard layouts too.

ai.lead: Plain machine translation can come out formal and long. With this on, an AI model writes the dub script in natural speech, fitted to the time of each sentence, and enables summaries and questions.
ai.enabledHint: Used for dubbing, summaries and questions

key.label: API key
key.saved: Saved ({hint}). Type a new key to replace it
key.helpClaude: From console.anthropic.com. Kept on this computer only and never shown again.
key.helpOther: Kept on this computer only and never shown again. Ollama needs no key.
key.willReset: Changing the provider or address removes the saved key, so it is never sent to a server it wasn't entered for. Enter the new key.

model.label: Model
model.helpClaude: Default {model}. A two-hour video costs roughly two or three dollars, and every sentence is cached so you never pay twice.
model.helpOther: Model names change. If this one no longer exists, use the current name from the provider's site.

saved.on: Saved. The next dub will use the dub writer.
saved.off: Saved. The dub writer is off.
saved.needKey: Saved, but it still needs an API key.
saved.needServer: Saved, but it still needs the server address and model name.

localOnly.title: Open this page on the computer itself
localOnly.body: AI settings hold a secret key, so they can only be changed from the computer Tarjuman runs on, not from a phone or another device on the network.

pronounce.lead: A word the voice says wrong? Write it and how to say it. This only changes the voice; the written subtitles stay as they are. Example: “UE5” is said “أنريل إنجن فايف”.
pronounce.saved: Dictionary saved. It applies to the next sentences.
pronounce.tryPh: Type a sentence with the word…

missing.title: This page doesn't exist
missing.body: The link may have changed. Start from the home page.

errors.NO_SERVER: The local server isn't running. Start it with python -m tarjuman, then reload.
errors.BAD_URL: That isn't a video link we can open. Copy it from the address bar and try again.
errors.UNPLAYABLE: YouTube won't give out this video's data. It may be private, need a sign-in, or be blocked in your country.
errors.CAPTIONS_EMPTY: YouTube returned an empty caption file for this video. Try again in a bit.
errors.NO_MEDIA: This video is no longer on your computer; it may have been deleted.
errors.NO_SPEECH: Whisper found no speech in this video.
errors.NO_JOB: The server lost this job, maybe it restarted. Start it again.
errors.NO_CUES: This video has no subtitle lines.
errors.BAD_JSON: The server sent a reply we couldn't read.
errors.PY_NOT_INSTALLED: This needs the Python environment. Run python -m tarjuman setup.
errors.WHISPER_NOT_INSTALLED: Whisper isn't installed. Run python -m tarjuman setup.
errors.TTS_FAILED: Couldn't generate the voice. Check the internet connection or install the local voices.
errors.FFMPEG_NOT_FOUND: FFmpeg is missing. Run python -m tarjuman setup.
errors.YTDLP_FAILED: Downloading the video failed. If it keeps happening, run python -m tarjuman update.
errors.MIX_FAILED: Mixing the audio into the video failed.
errors.BURN_FAILED: Burning the subtitles onto the picture failed.
errors.AI_NOT_READY: AI is off. Turn it on in Settings.
errors.AI_AUTH: The provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMIT: You hit the provider's rate limit. Wait a little and try again.
errors.AI_HTTP: The AI provider returned an error.
errors.AI_TRUNCATED: The model's reply was cut off.
errors.AI_SDK_MISSING: The provider's library isn't installed. Run python -m tarjuman setup.
errors.LOCAL_ONLY: This setting is only available on the computer Tarjuman runs on.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: The server refused this request for security reasons.
errors.NOT_PAIRED: This device isn't paired. Pair it from Settings, Phone, on the computer.
errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is bigger than the upload limit.
errors.DISK_FULL: There isn't enough disk space for this file.
errors.EXTENSION_NOT_ALLOWED: This extension isn't allowed. Allow it in the Tarjuman app under Settings, Extensions.
errors.JOBS_RUNNING: Jobs are running. Wait for them to finish, then try again.

phone.lead: Open Tarjuman on your phone over the same Wi-Fi. Each device is paired once, and an unpaired device can't reach your files.
phone.qrLabel: QR code to pair a phone
phone.step1: Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi.
phone.step2: Point the camera at the code and open the link.
phone.step3: Tarjuman opens on the phone and stays paired.
phone.firewall: On Windows, if the phone can't open the link, run scripts/allow-phone.ps1 once as administrator.
phone.resetDone: All devices were unpaired. Here is a new code.
phone.remote: This device is paired. Pairing is managed from the computer running Tarjuman.
phone.noLan: This computer isn't on a local network right now, so a phone can't be paired.
phone.unpairedTitle: This device isn't paired with Tarjuman
phone.unpairedBody: To protect your files, Tarjuman opens on other devices only after they are paired once.
phone.unpaired1: On the computer, open Tarjuman, then Settings, then Phone.
phone.unpaired2: Scan the QR code with this device's camera, or open the link under it.
phone.codeDone: A new code was made. Paired devices stay paired.
phone.codeHint: One code pairs any number of phones. A new code stops the old one without unpairing anyone.
phone.noDevices: No phone is paired yet. Scan the code with your phone and it will show up here.

extensions.lead: Browser extensions allowed to use Tarjuman. The first one that connects is trusted automatically; any other waits for your approval here.

storage.lead: What Tarjuman keeps on this computer. Clearing a cache is safe: it is rebuilt when needed, and your translation corrections are never cleared.
storage.voicesHint: The least recently used are removed automatically above {limit}
storage.tmpHint: Left by interrupted jobs; cleared at every start
